rows.name: CALDY ISLAND
rows.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
rows.description: The lt. is bright seaward, but is red toward Old Castle Head, from N. 70° W. to N. 56° W., and is red over Woolhouse Shoal from N. 55° E. to N. 15° E.

rows.name: ST. ANN'S POINT
rows.description: White towers, 75 and 42 ft., 610 ft. apart, on W. side. In one N. by W. ½ W., lead in clear of Crow and Toes Rocks. A red ray from high lighthouse shows over Chapel and Harbour Rocks to between S.E. ½ S. and E. ½ S. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes

rows.name: Great Castle Head
rows.description: In one, N.E. by E. ¾ E., lead in mid-channel

rows.name: Pembroke Dockyard
rows.description: Two red lts. in one lead up. High lt. shown betw. W. by N. ¾ N. & N.W. ¼ N. Low lt. betw. W. by N. ½ N. & N.N.E. A green sector betw. N. ¼ W. and N. by W. ¼ W. is shown over Carr Spit

rows.name: Neyland Pier
rows.description: Bright light near end of landing pier; red lt. occasionally on railway pier

rows.name: SMALLS
rows.description: Granite tower, 141 ft., red & white bands. Lt. bright seaward, from E. [?] S. to S.E. ½ E. The lt. is red over Hats and Barrels Rocks. Bell sounded, and rockets to explode sent up ev. half hour in fogs.

rows.name: S[?]UTH BISHOP ROCK
rows.description: A white tower, 36 feet high. A Gong in fogs. Fog-trumpet proposed

rows.name: New Quay
rows.description: On pier-head. To southward of E. ½ S. the light is red

rows.name: CARDIGAN BAY LT.-V.
rows.description: In 35 fathoms, at 20 miles northward from Port Cardigan Gong

rows.name: Aberystwith
rows.character: One fixed light Two bright fixed lights
rows.description: Harbour entrance, lt. red to S. and W., bright to N.W. and N.E. Two lts. in a field, over inner end of harbour, while sufficient water

rows.name: St. Tudwall Roads
rows.character: 1. One br. and red lt. 2. One lower red lt.
rows.description: 1. Vis. 8 secs., obscured 2 secs. White to westward betw. N. by E. and S. by W. Red from S. by W. to S.E. White from S.E. to N.E. by E. ½ E., and thence red to N. by E. Obscured by East Island, betw. N.E. ½ E. and E. by N. ½ N. 2. A ray with an arc of 15° is shown over Carreg-y-trai, from E. by S. to E. ½ N., from window 16 ft. below main light.

rows.name: BARDSEY ISLAND
rows.description: A square white tower, 99 ft. high. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 5 minutes

rows.name: CAERNARVON BAY LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 30 fathoms, at 12½ miles S.S.W. ¾ W. of South Stack light-ho. Flashes bright, bright and red. A small ball over large one. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 2 minutes

rows.name: SOUTH STACK ROCK
rows.description: White tower, 84 ft. During fogs, a smaller br. revol. lt., at 40 ft., is shown at 30 yds. N. of lt.-ho. A Fog-bell once ev. 15 secs.; also Gun (experimental, with holophone mouth-piece) fired ev. 10 min. from North Stack

rows.name: Holyhead
rows.character: 1. One red flash. lt. 7½ s. 2. One bright fixed lt. 3. One small red light 4. Red and green lights
rows.description: 1. Lighthouse on new breakwater. Fog Bell 3 times every 15 secs. Fog Horns for mail packets at 11 a.m. and 11.30 p.m. 2. On end of wooden jetty; old harbour Bell. 3. On old tower, to N.E., shown from N.E. to N.N.E. ½ E. to clear Platters. Fog Bell 4. Red lt. on starboard; green lt. on port side of inner harbour

rows.name: SKERRIES
rows.character: One bright fixed light Lower red light
rows.description: Upper lt. not visible over East Platters Rock, from S.S.E. to S.E. ½ S. Red lt. over Ethel and Coal Rocks, from E. ½ S. to E. by N. ¼ N. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes
